purpose: Convert the 43093 reference-only shoulder profile into physically grounded interface evidence.
Measure the intentional mating/contact region needed for exact articulation collision.
Establish repeatable force/torque/play/wear baselines before any production geometry promotion.

allowed_transitions: validated_prototype -> production_approved only after pre-registered acceptance criteria and repeated qualification

sampling.note: These are initial evidence-collection minima, not statistical guarantees or pass thresholds. Increase sample size when observed variation or risk justifies it.

instrumentation_and_recording.requirement: Use calibrated dimensional metrology appropriate to the feature; record instrument, resolution, calibration state, operator, specimen ID, temperature and measurement locations.
preferred_capabilities: optical/scan metrology for non-circular lobes, slots and internal mating geometry

instrumentation_and_recording.requirement: Use a controlled force fixture/test stand; record travel, speed, force-vs-displacement curve and peak/steady force rather than a hand-feel label.
Use a torque fixture; record joint angle, direction, breakaway peak, running torque and hysteresis.
Apply and record a defined small test load/displacement method; record direction and repeatability.

phases.objective: Measure real 43093 specimen variation and preserve raw geometry evidence.
records: total physical extents and feature stations
functional lobe/axle/pin cross-section measurements at repeatable datum locations
mass and material/marking observations where useful
specimen photographs/scans with scale and datum

phases.objective: Measure the official Giant torso and arm mating geometry instead of deriving socket dimensions from nominal LDraw surfaces.
records: intentional contact zones and non-contact clearance zones
reference coordinate frames tied to the shoulder pivot
phases.output_requirement: Produce candidate allowed-contact-region geometry with provenance; do not promote until functional tests agree.

phases.objective: Establish force/torque/play distributions of working official hardware/body/arm assemblies.
records: qualitative failure mode notes linked to quantitative traces

phases.objective: Measure degradation and failure modes instead of assuming initial fit persists.
phases.note: Checkpoints are an evidence-collection schedule, not pass/fail limits. Extend testing if behavior has not stabilized or failure is not characterized.
records: creep or permanent set after rest

phases.objective: Test each actual process/material/orientation/interface revision against the official/reference distribution.
phases.rule: Do not pool unlike process/material/orientation revisions as if they were one population.

phases.objective: Pre-register qualification limits after pilot data exists and before formal candidate qualification.
requirements: define acceptable force/torque/play bands from functional baseline and use-case needs
define dimensional control features and inspection method
freeze the tested interface revision before qualification

promotion_requirements: Raw physical measurements retained with provenance.
Intentional contact region explicitly modeled from validated evidence.
Candidate interface passes pre-registered functional criteria.
Cycle/wear behavior is characterized at the intended use level.
No unresolved safety/structural/fit-critical review flags remain.
Promotion decision references the exact tested geometry/process/material revision.
